messages:
ana: Quick thread 1. Product wants a Composer pricing pilot: priority lane + reserved throughput + per-route caps. Need launch checklist.

liz: 3pm sync ok. What SLO numbers do we promise?

sam: Proposal: p50 <= 30ms, p95 <= 120ms for interactive prompts on priority lane. Fallback to standard documented.

mohit: Implementation: soft-priority router weights for GA, dedicated pools for Pro. Soft priority infra delta ~+20%.

ralph: Sales prefers discounted pilot (25% off) with a short commit so we get billing signals.

legal: I'll draft a Pilot Addendum (timeboxed, limited liability) and an Enterprise SLA. No "unlimited" language.

ops-bot: Attached export: https://internal.redwood/exports/top-routes-q4.csv

liz: Add quality guardrail: <5% regression on composer eval set.

sam: Launch criteria: 3 customers in pilot for 4 weeks, quality guardrail met, pricing + legal approved, rollback tested.

mohit: Need console instrumentation before GA: per-tenant token traces and per-route throttle counters.

ana: Action items:
- ana: book sync and send RFC stub
- liz: eval prompts by EOD
- sam: pricing uplift table tomorrow
- mohit: infra estimate 24h
- legal: pilot addendum 48h
- ops-bot: attach perf traces

ana: Will post RFC after the sync and set follow-up T+3 days.
